Definition: apparently a primary verb; to dig:--dig.
BiblicalUsage: Skapto means to dig, and Jesus uses it for foundations and for excuses. The wise man digged deep and laid his foundation on a rock, the keeper of the vineyard asks for one more year to dig about the fig tree, and the unjust steward confesses he cannot dig and is ashamed to beg.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe digging deep is the difference between a house and a ruin, because the flood finds every foundation sooner or later.
